reviews.author: steve wallace
reviews.text: Was out last night buying some cars wholesale in Asheboro NC bout 8 pm had a ramp come off trailer while putting a truck on the trailer so i was stuck!! So i called Blakes Towing the was very nice on the phone!! They sent a young man out to help me out his name was Dalton he was very nice young man he helped me get the truck up and back on the trailer!! Done a great job great price! Could not ask for anything better!! Very fair and you could tell this young man cares about his job!!! So if you need a tow call Blakes Towing you will not be disappointed!!! Just like to say takes again for the great service!!

reviews.author: Amy Todd
reviews.text: We definitely recommend these guys to anyone who needs a tow. Had been trying all day to find someone to tow my husband’s truck home (8 miles) due to wheel hub assembly broke and wheel broke off with it. Everyone we called all day wanted an arm and a leg. Last shot of the night and these guys were so efficient and so much help. Real good quote given, quick to location, and got the hooked fast and home. Hopefully won’t need a tow again but if I do definitely calling these guys. Thanks a bunch!

reviews.author: Tim Lovin
reviews.text: Mike came out within twenty minutes. Very professional and easy to talk to. Mike also gave me good advice regarding my vehicle issue. His truck was clean and well kept. Good experience and would recommend this towing/ roadside service. The gentleman I spoke to over the phone was also well spoken and professional.

reviews.author: sarah
reviews.text: Very rude, tried to overcharge for a small tow out the ditch. Got very upset when i told him he was expensive. He continued to be rude and tell us that other companies would charge us the same as he did when somebody came and charged us way less and so much more polite in this vulnerable time. Dont spend your money with them they are overpriced and so mean to the people.

reviews.author: Jerie Jacobson
reviews.text: When everything looked bleak as far as getting out of the mud. Blake's came to our rescue. Very courteous, friendly reasonable & responsive people. They care, they really care about their clients. Hope we don't need a tow anytime soon, however if we do we're calling Blake's!

reviews.author: Harrington Classic Car Restorations
reviews.text: They are amazing. Always who I go to to transport our classic cars and our personal cars when needed. Great crew.

reviews.author: Angie
reviews.text: We had our vehicle towed by this company after another driver totaled our vehicle. We had a few issues on our end, and both the owner and his wife were so pleasant and accommodating throughout the process. It was probably the best experience we've had so far out of this entire ordeal. Thank you for taking care of us!

reviews.author: Bones XXX
reviews.text: The best towing company. Wife and I were in need of a towing - it happens. When it does you want to call Blakes Towing. Thank y’all for your efficiency and kindness when we were stranded. It was such a blessing. Again, thank y’all for going above and beyond when we needed help!

reviews.author: Jay P
reviews.text: Best towing service in Asheboro!!! They worked with me over the phone, and the young lady who works there is very nice! If I broke down again I know who to call. They do not mess around with price or give you a hassle. I'd recommend Blake's over asheboro towing and Lydia's. Blake's is very professional and a good towing service to support

reviews.author: Terri
reviews.text: This place is rude and I felt like I was robbed the way they impounded my car and was so expensive I couldn't afford to get my car out and lost it...This happened to me twice. They wouldn't let me get my stuff unless I showed them the title.i had misplaced it and they refused to budge on price. Every other time I have had vehicle towed or impounded they always worked with me but not Blake's. Do not use this company unless you want to cause serious trouble and big money for someone . Too many other places that are so much more courteous and understanding . There is nothing I can say to make this company good. I don't see how they sleep at night being so rude and hateful to someone put in a predicament like I was in. God help them to be more kind.

reviews.author: Melissa Kelly
reviews.text: We were heading on vacation when we had gotten 2 flat tires in the middle of the night. We called a few other tow company’s who were not willing to help us but Blake’s Towing was. They were extremely nice and helpful and his wife came along also to transport our family of 5 to a hotel until we could have the tires fixed in the morning. We could not be more grateful for them and they were very reasonably priced. I would definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Mary George Smith
reviews.text: Super helpful over the phone!! Solved our flat tire problem via phone by a Google search. He made no money for his company but went over and above to help us! Thank you!

reviews.author: Sybil Desimone
reviews.text: My son had an incident. His vehicle was towed by this establishment. It was in their possession less then 2 hours. We called and they informed us it would be $400 in cash. We arrived and the owner and his wife had a huge dog, which was used as an intimidation tactic. They were arrogant and obviously desperate to take advantage of individuals in their most vulnerable state.

reviews.author: Jen Cobb
reviews.text: Broke down on 220,called Blake's and they gave me a great quote for towing,had it done super fast,and was so kind and courteous with me and my daughter.I have used many tow companies and Blake's beats them all with how professional they treated me.I recommend their services highly.

reviews.author: Marty Kinley
reviews.text: In a time of great stress, Blakes towing was able to make a tough situation..comforting. My car broke down at 5 am in the morning, in the pouring rain. I was unable to pull off onto the side of the road. I was in a bad spot. I called Blakes. They where there in minutes. After they got my car loaded quickly onto a rollback. He looked at me and said …” where do you live, I’ll get you home “ Blakes made me feel like they had compassion for my situation instead of “ just another tow” I hope I never have another break down on the road, but if I do, I’m calling Blakes towing

reviews.author: Brian Miller
reviews.text: I gave them five stars. Arrived when they said they would, talked us through the whole process, and delivered my daughter’s car right where we wanted it. Very polite, courteous, and affordable for what we had done!! Thank y’all so much!!

reviews.author: Qua Santiago
reviews.text: I just want to say thank youuuuu !!!! You guys are a life saver , my car broke down on me last night 4/19/22 around 8 something going on 9 pm . I was coming from Fayetteville going home to Asheboro and had about 47 mins left home . My car lights came on & hood was smoking some . I pulled over to the side of the road & called a few other companies but to no avail, everyone seemed like they didn’t care, but Blake’s? Oh man he gave me hope & had me smiling from ear to ear after I was crying because I thought me and my 5 year old daughter was going to be stranded in the cold on the side of a dark interstate. I want to thank you guys soooo much ! I will call you guys in a heart beat !’ Great business, very professional, and friendly ! Please keep up the good work! You have a forever customer if I ever run into this or something similar again.

reviews.author: Christopher Knight
reviews.text: Very professional and great customer service! They responded very quickly and had my car loaded and dropped off in another town faster than I could have hoped for! I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Joe Ford
reviews.text: Well as much as I'd love to say it was great...it was just ok...as I keep my maintenance up on my vehicle's and have not A need for Blake's toeN All we got was a free Blake's toeN hat an dull pocket knife Thanks Charlie Ed Blake & Son's

reviews.author: Hannah Bales
reviews.text: Very professional and provided exceptional service. Blake’s towing went above and beyond to assist me when I needed help the most. I will definitely be using them again in the future when the need arises.

reviews.author: Seymour Digital Marketing
reviews.text: Blakes helped us tremendously in the middle of nowhere! They certainly helped when we would have been toast without them. Quick service and professional!

reviews.author: Bill B
reviews.text: Excellent service and very reasonable rates. No one likes having to call a tow truck, but if it's necessary, Blake's Towing is the one to call.

reviews.author: Sarah Iglesias
reviews.text: I called and they answered right away. Reassured me and came right out. Professional, and also kind, which counts in a stressful situation! Highly recommend this company should you ever need a tow.

reviews.author: Jacob Hohn
reviews.text: I was called out to do a repair on one of their truck’s air tanks. Let me put it this way, I’ve never needed a tow in my life, but I know who I would call if I ever do from now on though.

reviews.author: Lyssa McDonald
reviews.text: Very easy to work with and get in touch with! they towed my husbands jeep that blew a tire in the middle of a storm! great family business!

reviews.author: Kristi Anderson
reviews.text: Very pleased with services rendered. Everyone was very professional and caring, you can tell this is a family oriented business. Thank you for taking care of us.

reviews.author: Stacie Kivett
reviews.text: Absolutely great! Great customer service and fast at getting my car to the garage. Would highly recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Jamie Mescher
reviews.text: Very prompt service! Good communication start to finish. Very helpful & fair. I highly recommend Blakes Towing! A+

reviews.author: Amanda Feather
reviews.text: They are amazing very professional, great service, very affordable. I highly recommend them for all your towing needs they can do it all.

reviews.author: Rebecca Hoffman
reviews.text: Best service. Very kind man. Very thoughtful when pulling my Suv out od the ditch. Thank You for your help.

reviews.author: Keith Johnson
reviews.text: Great towing company , very reasonable prices for local towing . They have all my business from now on.

reviews.author: crystal gil
reviews.text: This is a great company he hooked me up bringing my camper from brumswick georgia to sophia great guy.
